analyst_view.overall: Leaders PSV (29 pts from 13) host Go Ahead Eagles (9th, 17 pts), who lost 1-0 at home to Fortuna Sittard on 22 November, their first home defeat of the season. PSV won 4-1 at NEC on Saturday but lost captain Mauro Junior to a groin injury until 2027; Jerdy Schouten and Alassane Plea are also out and Ricardo Pepi is only just back. PSV play Real Madrid away in the Champions League on Tuesday 24 November, so this comes four days after a draining away night, though their league lead means Peter Bosz is unlikely to rest many. Go Ahead had Dean James, Evert Linthorst and Richonell Margaret not fit before the Fortuna game. None of these absences are in the numbers yet (no team news was on file), and no referee is named.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.4 goals, mostly from PSV (3.3), who have scored 19 in their last six. Losing both holding midfielders, Mauro Junior and Schouten, may cost PSV some control but also leaves more room for Go Ahead's counters, so the two effects roughly cancel; PSV's attack (Til, Perisic, Van Bommel, Pepi back) is intact. I stay at 4.4.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.1 corners, with PSV taking about 7 as they pin opponents back. Go Ahead have had injury problems on the flanks (Margaret, James) and lost their last home game, which fits a deep defensive approach in Eindhoven that the numbers already expect. Nothing new on the wide players, so I stay at 11.1.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.7 cards. Go Ahead have been booked rarely lately (4 in six games, already counted) and PSV's Dest and Obispo were one caution from a ban before the Madrid game, which could make them a little careful. The referee is not named yet; I stay at 2.7.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.7 shots, with PSV at 25. I trim it slightly, to about 33.7: PSV come off a Tuesday night at the Bernabeu, and without Mauro Junior and Schouten they lose the two midfielders who usually win the ball back and recycle attacks, which the numbers do not know about. It is a mild lean, as PSV's front line is fit and they have been dominant at home.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 12.0 shots on target. PSV's finishing quality up front is unchanged with Til and Perisic expected to play and Pepi back on the bench, while Go Ahead's own attack (Tengstedt scored in their recent wins) has gone quiet. The midfield absences mostly affect volume, not chance quality, so I stay at 12.0.
